description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Romello Height was back at practice at 49ers training camp on Monday.
items.impact: Height makes his return from an elbow injury.
items.title: Romello Height (elbow) returns to practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: C.J. West was back at practice at 49ers training camp on Monday.
items.impact: West missed time over the weekend.
items.title: C.J. West returns to practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carson Schwesinger did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Schwesinger is dealing with a minor injury. He is day-to-day.
items.title: Carson Schwesinger misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carrington Valentine did not practice on Monday due to a hamstring injury.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is. Valentine won't be rushed back.
items.title: Carrington Valentine (hamstring) misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jacob Parrish did not practice on Monday due to a lower body injury.
items.impact: Parrish is dealing with lower body soreness. He is day-to-day.
items.title: Jacob Parrish (lower body) misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen McMillan did not practice on Monday due to a lower body injury.
items.impact: McMillan is dealing with lower body soreness. He is day-to-day.
items.title: Jalen McMillan (lower body) misses practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saahdiq Charles left Monday's practice with a calf injury.
items.impact: Charles has been filling in for Damien Lewis in training camp for Carolina.
items.title: Saahdiq Charles suffers calf injury Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos LB Drew Sanders returned to practice on Monday.
items.impact: It is unclear what capacity Sanders was able to return to.
items.title: Drew Sanders returns to practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots signed DT Casey Rogers.
items.impact: Rogers most recently played for the DC Defenders in the UFL this spring. He previously spent time on the Giants practice squad.
items.title: Casey Rogers signs with Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Demond Claiborne practiced in full pads on the rehab field Monday.
items.impact: The rookie is expected to compete for the RB3 role in the Vikings backfield.
items.title: Demond Claiborne practices on rehab field Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals claimed DT Cam Horsley off waivers.
items.impact: Horsely was waived by the Titans over the weekend.
items.title: Cam Horsley claimed off waivers by Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said TE TE Davis Allen is dealing with a quad.
items.impact: McVay said they will give Allen "some time" before he returns to practice. "Davis is going to be a big part of what we do," McVay said. He won't be on the fantasy radar.
items.title: Davis Allen dealing with quad injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said RB Trey Benson is dealing with "just a little discomfort" in his knee.
items.impact: The injury has kept Benson out of practice. It doesn't appear to be a long-term concern.
items.title: Trey Benson dealing with knee discomfort

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals claimed RB Evan Hull off waivers from the Texans.
items.impact: Hull will compete for a depth role in the backfield for Arizona.
items.title: Evan Hull claimed off waivers by Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens signed OL Kendall Lamm.
items.impact: Lamm was one of three offensive linemen to work out for Baltimore on Monday. He'll compete for a depth role.
items.title: Kendall Lamm signs with Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters he expects Josh Sweat to be ready to go for Week 1.
items.impact: Sweat opened training camp on the PUP list. He can be activated at any point in August.
items.title: Josh Sweat expected to be ready for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chiefs signed WR Jeff Weimer.
items.impact: Weimer will compete for a depth role in the Chiefs wide receiver room.
items.title: Jeff Weimer signs with Chiefs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed CB Mekhi Rodgers.
items.impact: Rodgers will compete for a depth role in the Colts corner back room.
items.title: Mekhi Rodgers signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders activated LB Kain Medrano from the PUP list.
items.impact: Medrano has been cleared to return to practice this week.
items.title: Kain Medrano (hamstring) activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots activated RB Terrell Jennings from the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Jennings has been cleared to return to practice this week.
items.title: Terrell Jennings activated from NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers activated OL Brant Banks from the PUP list.
items.impact: Banks has been cleared to return to practice this week.
items.title: Brant Banks activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens activated DT John Jenkins from the PUP list.
items.impact: Jenkins has been cleared to return to practice this week.
items.title: John Jenkins activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals waived Tejhaun Palmer.
items.impact: Palmer will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Tejhaun Palmer waived by Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals waived Coziah Izzard.
items.impact: Izzard signed with Arizona in July. He will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Coziah Izzard waived by Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns waived TJ Harden.
items.impact: Harden will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: TJ Harden waived by Browns
